description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'CandidateAllowedActionAPITest' that tests the 'CandidateAllowedActionAPI' related to recruitment API functionalities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup procedures, data providers, and test methods to verify API behaviors, especially focusing on unimplemented methods and the 'getAll' API endpoint.
